test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"caused."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Caused" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"Caused"** means to make something happen. (कुछ होने का कारण बनना, उत्‍पन्‍न करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The fire was **caused**__ by an electrical fault.*
 
 
 
• It is in the past tense and fits the context of something that has already happened.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**: 

An 'occupational disease' is any disease __**caused**__ primarily by exposure at work ______ (2) ______ a physical, organisational, chemical or biological risk ______ (3) ______ or to a combination of these factors. Occupational diseases are ______ (4) ______ those listed in national legislation as resulting from exposure to risk factors at ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Abated"** means to become less intense or widespread. (प्रकोप या प्रभाव का कम हो जाना या कम करना; धीमा होना)
 
• Option 3: **"Posed" **means to present a problem or difficulty. (किसी के लिए कोई प्रश्‍न उत्‍पन्‍न या प्रस्‍तुत करना (जिसे निपटाया जाना हो) किसी को निपटाने के लिए कुछ दे देना या कुछ परेशानी उत्‍पन्‍न कर देना)
 
• Option 4:** "Flawed"** means to have a defect or imperfection. (कोई दोष या अपूर्णता होना)

1ef:Td16,

The correct answer is **"to."**
